value.rationale: The natural fixed average interrogation-interval budget leads to an exact constrained quantum-control frontier with two sharp phase boundaries and a complete description of all optimal timing laws. It exhibits a paradoxical high-budget regime where mixing perfect coherent peaks yields finite detection despite a same-mean deterministic protocol having infinite detection time at Rabi zeros, while the low-budget optimizer avoids quantum-Zeno divergence using strongly nonuniform intervals. This is motivated structural and exact control information not present in the known unconstrained optimum.
